description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states. Use it in forms and settings when presenting a moderate number of options. Keyboard typeahead matches a native select: typing on the focused closed trigger selects the matching option directly, repeated presses cycle through options sharing a first letter, and spaces count as match characters ("new y" reaches "New York").
